name: seismograph-line
title: Seismograph Line
description: A hairline divider bends toward the cursor as it passes and springs back with a small wobble, like a needle on a seismograph.

meta.useWhen: Dividers on calm editorial pages where one living detail is enough; sound, measurement and science brands.
meta.avoidWhen: Every divider; busy pages; pages that already have a cursor effect.
